note: City of Buena Vista park (Glen Maury Park) on the Maury River. Lower campground: open grassy RV/tent sites without gravel pads (Rally Field, Riverside, The Island, Water's Edge), water and electric, no sewer, bath house and dump station. Upper campground: wooded gravel-pad sites at Hill Top and Oak Ridge, many full hookup, not recommended for rigs over 32 ft. Electric is 30 or 50 amp. Reservations by phone (540-261-7321); walk-ups may ask about availability on arrival. Campers may be asked to pay admission or move during city events. --Claude
summary: City page now prices camping at $70 W/E base to $80 full hookup (was unpriced); electric 30 -> 50 amp; reservations by phone (reservable false -> true, platform phone, fcfs 'always' cleared); dump station; site layout noted. flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is riverview, but the city names lower-campground RV areas 'Riverside' (sites 104-115) and 'Water's Edge' (open grassy sites for RVs, campers and tents).
Rates look high for a municipal park ($70 W/E, $55 tent); earlier city/news pages said $35-40 non-resident. The page carries the 2026 kiosk map, so it reads as current, but it is the only source.
